rows.ja: 原油調達・在庫金融(上流)

relations.text: ハワイ製油所向けの原油を購入・納入(在庫金融)
relations.text_en: Buys and delivers crude oil to the Hawaii refinery (inventory financing)

source.label: Par Pacific 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We have the Inventory Intermediation Agreement with Citigroup Energy Inc. ("Citi"), pursuant to which Citi will purchase and deliver crude oil to our Hawaii refinery.

relations.text: 再生燃料の原料調達の資金を提供(2025年)

source.label: Par Pacific 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On October 2, 2025, we entered into an agreement with Wells Fargo (the "Renewables Intermediation Agreement") to, among other things, provide funding to finance renewables feedstock.

companies.name: ハワイアン・エレクトリック

relations.text: ハワイの電力会社に発電用の燃料を供給
relations.text_en: Supplies fuel to Hawaii's electric utilities

source.label: Hawaiian Electric 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On February 1, 2022, the Utilities and PAR Hawaii Refining, LLC (PAR Hawaii) entered into a fuel supply contract (Supply Agreement) commencing January 1, 2023.

relations.text: ハワイの再生燃料工場の合弁(Alohi経由で出資)
relations.text_en: Partner in the Hawaii renewable fuels joint venture (through Alohi)

source.label: Par Pacific 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: entered into a definitive Equity Contribution Agreement (the "Equity Contribution Agreement") with Alohi Renewable Energy LLC ("Alohi"), an entity owned by Mitsubishi Corporation and ENEOS Corporation, to establish Hawaii Renewables as a joint venture.
